reason: May 5 reporting names WHO epidemic and pandemic preparedness and prevention director Maria Van Kerkhove as the official publicly coordinating the operational sequence with Spain: urgent evacuation of two sick crew members, onward sailing to the Canary Islands, a full epidemiological investigation, ship disinfection and passenger risk assessment. This direct operational role sharply supersedes the prior inference from Hans Kluge's regional statement.

Hilton led Emerson's April poll at 17%, three points ahead of Steyer and Bianco, and May 5 reporting still places him first after Bianco fell and Steyer and Becerra benefited from Swalwell's exit. A newer CBS poll has Hilton only one point ahead of Steyer, so Hilton is a modest majority favorite rather than an overwhelming one for Emerson's May 13 release.

Manchester City's 3-3 draw at Everton leaves Arsenal five points clear with a game in hand for City but an easier final schedule for Arsenal, materially strengthening the title-winner narrative for Rice and other Arsenal candidates. Haaland nevertheless scored his 25th league goal and remains the narrow individual-award favorite.
